operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to publish the long-form guide in September.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the long-form guide progressing? I can help organize the publication timeline and editorial tasks.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Earlier, I planned to publish the long-form guide in September.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. Has the timeline changed, or are you still working toward that original month?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I now plan to publish the guide in October.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: October gives you additional room for the remaining editorial work. What components still need attention?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The guide will include interviews with three practitioners.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Those interviews can add useful firsthand perspective. Is the structure of the guide settled yet?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The editor is reviewing the final chapter list.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Once that review is complete, you can align the interviews and remaining copy with the approved structure.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the production plan to reflect the revised publication month and the editorial review.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. A concise production plan can track the chapter-list review, interview material, revisions, and publication preparation in sequence.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please help me turn those workstreams into a practical checklist.
